claim_text: Hurricane Iniki, a Category 4 storm, was the last hurricane to hit Hawaii, making landfall on the southern coast of Kauai in 1992 and causing six deaths and $3bn in damage.
quote: Iniki, a powerful category four storm, was the last hurricane to hit Hawaii back in 1992. It caused six deaths and $3bn in damage after making landfall on the southern coast of Kauai.
